content_zh:
训练的间歇时间，林锐靠在基地厚重的墙边喘息着。这时秦奋轻轻推了他一下，低声道，“这几天是怎么了？老黑和唐疯子简直像是打了鸡血一样，没完没了地折腾。”
林锐摇摇头，并没有说话，虽然他也有些察觉这几天训练营的气氛有些异常。
金浩山压低声音道，“你们没有听说？据说我们的训练时间被缩短了。整整一年半的训练计划被要求在半年内完成，而且我听说，两个月之后我们就要上战场了。祸福难料啊，兄弟。”
秦奋苦笑道，“我看是凶多吉少才对。”
金浩山凑过来压低声音道，“我听说，两个月之后，我们要进行一次考核。这可不是什么演习，而是真枪实弹的实战对抗。到时候子弹可不会长眼。”
林锐皱眉道，“你听谁说的？”
“还能有谁，那个叫白熊的厨子。这货每天都躲在后面喝酒，一喝醉了什么都吐。总算是这几个月的俄语没有白学，我大概套出了他几句话。”金浩山低声道，“这可是拿咱们的命当炮灰啊。怎么样，考虑过我之前的提议没有？”
“什么提议？”林锐平静地道。
“逃出去啊。”金浩山眼神闪烁道，“我已经观察过了，那些守卫的换岗时间是有规律的。他们走到外面完成交接，至少有两分钟的时间。足够我潜入军火库，弄到炸药的。”
“两分钟时间，你要开启地下军火库的门，搞定报警装置，并且找到炸药，还得弄出来。你觉得你可以完成？老毛子的东西都是傻大笨粗，但是足够坚固。这老式苏俄基地钢筋混凝土结构的坚固程度是你想象不到的。”林锐看着金浩山道，“而且这个基地里没有C4炸药。靠训练用的硝基炸药，你觉得多少才够炸出一条路来？”
金浩山愣住了，他呆呆地看着林锐。
但是林锐并没有说完，他指着外面淡淡地道，“在外面这条走廊里，一共有十四个隐藏的监控摄像头，可以真正做到无死角监控。而且我敢肯定，晨星公司的安保人员在一直盯着这些监控画面。预测和评估潜在的危险。你和你那个同伴早就是他们注意的目标了。”
金浩山吃了一惊，低声道，“这不可能，我们从来没有发现过有什么摄像监控。那条路我们暗中走了几遍，都没有出事。”
林锐冷冷一笑道，“你并没有注意到这些。因为那些摄像头不是像通常的那样装在上面，而且是装在墙角的下方，以仰视的角度监控来往的所有人。这种方式不但隐蔽，而且没有监控死角。所以你也根本别想用通常的方法躲避。你和你的同伴之所以还没事，是因为你们还没有什么实质性的行动。你要真的企图“可是他们为什么要监控我们？”秦奋忍不住道。
“难道你觉得他们应该信任我们？”林锐反问道，“不相信我的话，你可以和他一起尝试一下逃跑。不过我还是那句话，佣兵生涯虽然危险，但是不作死就不会死。”
外面的蜂鸣警报再次响起，赵建飞的声音又在咆哮，“全体集合！快点快点，再快点。别逼我踹你们的屁股。”
“妈的，又开始了。这才休息几分钟，这老赵是要玩死我们么……”秦奋哭笑不得。
林锐拍了拍他，低声道，“走吧，保持警觉，低调行事。”
这三十六位佣兵学员再次在地下训练场集合了起来，赵建飞冷冷地道，“我发现你们之中有些人在训练间歇不肯好好休息，而喜欢在基地里乱逛。既然你们这样精力过剩，那么不妨我们继续来点刺激的训练。你们不是已经分成六人小组了么？那么很好，以小组为单位分批训练。训练的内容是战术动作。”
林锐等人这时才算是松了一口气，他们现在最怕的不是战术动作训练，而是真正折磨人的体能训练。战术训练只是摸爬滚打而已，但体内训练却是要榨干他们体内最后一点力量，不把他们练得精疲力竭就不罢休。所以听到赵建飞说训练的科目是战术动作，几乎所有人都感到了一丝庆幸。

content_en:
During the interval of training, Lin Rui leaned against the thick wall of the base and panted. At this time, Qin Fen pushed him gently and whispered, "What's going on these days? Lao Hei and Madman Tang are like chicken blood, tossing endlessly."
Lin Rui shook his head and said nothing, although he also noticed that the atmosphere in the training camp these days was abnormal.
Jin Haoshan lowered his voice and said, "Didn't you hear? It is said that our training time has been shortened. The training plan for a full year and a half is required to be completed within half a year, and I heard that we will go to the battlefield in two months. It is unpredictable, brother."
Qin Fen smiled bitterly and said, "I think it's more likely to be bad than good."
Jin Haoshan came over and lowered his voice and said, "I heard that in two months, we will have an assessment. This is not an exercise, but an actual combat confrontation with real guns and live ammunition. The bullets will not have holes by then."
Lin Rui frowned and said, "Who did you listen to?"
"Who else could it be? The cook named White Bear. This guy hides in the back and drinks every day. When he is drunk, he vomits everything. Finally, I have learned Russian in the past few months, and I probably got a few words out of him." Jin Haoshan whispered, "This is using our lives as cannon fodder. How about it, have you considered my previous proposal?"
"What proposal?" Lin Rui said calmly.
"Escape." Jin Haoshan said with twinkling eyes, "I have already observed that the guard changing time is regular. They walked outside to complete the handover, which took at least two minutes. It was enough for me to sneak into the arsenal and get the explosives."
"In two minutes, you have to open the door of the underground arsenal, fix the alarm device, find the explosives, and get them out. Do you think you can finish it? Lao Maozi's things are all stupid and bulky, but they are strong enough. The strength of the reinforced concrete structure of this old Soviet-Russian base is beyond your imagination." Lin Rui looked at Jin Haoshan and said, "And there is no C4 explosive in this base. With the nitro explosives used for training, how much do you think is enough to blast a way out?"
Jin Haoshan was stunned and looked at Lin Rui blankly.
But Lin Rui did not finish speaking. He pointed outside and said calmly, "In the corridor outside, there are a total of fourteen hidden surveillance cameras, which can truly monitor blind spots. And I am sure that the security personnel of Morning Star Company have been watching these surveillance images to predict and assess potential dangers. You and your companion have long been the targets of their attention."
Jin Haoshan was taken aback and whispered, "This is impossible. We have never found any surveillance cameras. We have walked that road several times in secret, and nothing happened."
Lin Rui smiled coldly and said, "You didn't notice this. Because those cameras are not mounted on top as usual, but are mounted below the corner of the wall to monitor everyone coming and going from a upward angle. This method is not only concealed, but also has no monitoring blind spots. So you don't even think about using the usual methods to avoid it. The reason why you and your companions are still fine is because you haven't taken any substantive action yet. You have to really try. "But why are they monitoring us? "Qin Fen couldn't help but said.
"Do you think they should trust us? Lin Rui asked, "If you don't believe me, you can try to escape with him." But I still say that, although the mercenary career is dangerous, you will not die if you don't seek death. "
The buzzer alarm outside sounded again, and Zhao Jianfei’s voice roared again, “Everyone gather! Hurry up, hurry up, hurry up. Don't make me kick your ass. "
“Damn, it’s starting again. We have only rested for a few minutes, is this old Zhao trying to kill us..." Qin Fen didn't know whether to laugh or cry.
Lin Rui patted him and whispered, "Let's go, stay alert and keep a low profile. "
The thirty-six mercenary students gathered again in the underground training ground. Zhao Jianfei said coldlySaid, "I found that some of you refuse to take a good rest during training intervals, but like to wander around the base. Since you have so much energy, let's continue some exciting training. Aren't you already divided into six-person groups? That's good, train in groups as a group. The content of the training is tactical movements."
Lin Rui and others were relieved at this time. What they feared most now was not the tactical training, but the truly torturous physical training. Tactical training is just a struggle, but internal training is to squeeze out the last bit of strength in their bodies, and they will not stop until they are exhausted. So when Zhao Jianfei said that the training subject was tactical movements, almost everyone felt a little lucky.
